title: The folder, opened
logline: The (finch) folder open on the reading-room table and the first sheet in it: not a strip — a photocopy of a 1997 Timberline front page, the strip's back page turned to the front by the copy. The archive's order, not his. He leaves it that way.

panels.composition: A gray folder open on a library table under a green lamp with a photocopied 1997 school newspaper front page on top, the copy slightly skewed.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a gray folder open on a library table under a green-shaded lamp with a photocopied school newspaper front page on top slightly skewed, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
